questions.prompt: While plan mode is on, the model calls bash to run the tests. What happens?
options: The call runs under the normal sandbox and approval rules
The call waits until the plan is approved
questions.explanation: Plan mode only adds guidance. The sandbox mode and the approval policy enforce limits, and they do not read plan mode.

questions.prompt: The person answers keep planning with some feedback. What does the model receive?
options: A failed tool call that carries the feedback
A new turn with plan mode off
questions.explanation: Keep planning makes exit_plan_mode fail with the person's feedback, so the model reads it as an error and revises the plan.

questions.prompt: Why does a selection wait for the next pre-step before it is written as a plan/mode event?
options: Events can only be written at night
The pre-step is where the loop accepts new facts for a step, so the request and the record agree
The model must approve the selection first
A selection written at once would delete the todo list
questions.explanation: Appending at the accepted pre-step puts the change into the record exactly when the guidance starts to apply to a request.
